presets.name: Watercolour
presets.visualDescription: Soft watercolour illustration with translucent washes, visible paper grain, gentle colour bleeds and loose, hand-painted edges.

presets.name: Crayon
presets.visualDescription: Waxy children's crayon drawing with bold, textured strokes, bright saturated colours and a little white paper showing through.

presets.name: Cut paper
presets.visualDescription: Layered cut-paper collage with crisp shapes, flat colours, subtle shadows between layers and a handmade, tactile feel.

presets.name: Gouache
presets.visualDescription: Opaque gouache painting with flat, matte colour areas, visible brush marks and a warm, slightly chalky finish.

presets.name: Ink and wash
presets.visualDescription: Loose pen-and-ink linework with delicate watercolour wash over it, expressive lines and plenty of white space.

presets.name: Coloured pencil
presets.visualDescription: Hand-drawn coloured pencil artwork with fine hatching, soft layered colour and a visible paper texture.

presets.name: Digital storybook
presets.visualDescription: Clean digital storybook illustration with smooth shapes, rich saturated colours, soft lighting and friendly, rounded characters.

presets.name: Linocut print
presets.visualDescription: Bold linocut-style print with chunky carved lines, limited flat ink colours and a slightly uneven, printed texture.
